baseline.reportedResult: WebGPU failure in the local-subsets case caused by a stale expected CPU-stage list.

remoteCi.correction: The test now checks the exact documented CPU-stage list, including calibrated rotation hypotheses; numerical/local-BA assertions are retained. The exact affected-list tests and targeted case passed locally.
remoteCi.note: Source-commit CI remains separate from local checks. The final evidence-only delivery commit will trigger its own CI; query the PR head before merging.

limitations: Software WebGPU evidence only; no physical GPU measurements.
No new general-video geometry accuracy gain is established by grouping execution plans.
The default remains the existing separate-pass schedule.
Three repeated runs are limited workload evidence, not statistical or hardware generalization.
No automatic mask/cut pipeline, full-clip reconstruction, dynamic-object shape or combined #222/#223 execution is added.
sourceHashScope: Reports identify the measurement workspace in both modes. The historical compiled bundle is independently mapped to the baseline commit by its retained SHA256; workspace source hashes do not identify that old bundle.

methodology.historicalBaselinePolicy: Old compiled baseline does not implement batchPasses; its original schedule is confirmed by real plan counters.
methodology.advancedTrackingControls: Geometry/surface patch proposals and multi-view consistency are enabled identically in both modes; these are opt-in algorithm controls, not API defaults.
methodology.caseWarmth: Fixed six-case order shares a device inside each browser; later cases are not independently cold. Timestamp profiles have a separate photo/video order and change scheduling.
methodology.summary: Ratios of mode medians, with all raw min/max stages retained; not paired-ratio averages or a statistical/hardware conclusion.
methodology.timers: Browser totals exclude startup/transport/fixture generation. ffmpeg video preparation is separate. Cached photo feature/matching original costs are excluded.
methodology.inputConditions: Four supplied-K RGB synthetic scenes, 12 supplied-K RGB photos with cached RGB-derived features/matches, six-frame uploaded video window with manual crop/background mask and assumed K. Pose/depth truth stays outside reconstruction.
methodology.counterScope: Application Resident upload/read prefixes/snapshots and allocator storage. Plan counters wrap actual device.plan and returned runtime submission reports; not physical fences/bus traffic. Driver/uniform-ring/host-heap peaks are not measured.

quality.definition: Exact serialized accepted-observation hashes, finite-model hashes and fixed-cohort/input-output-feature evidence after the same wrapper normalization (missing initialization means initialized). This is not a claim of raw GPU bit identity or improved accuracy.
quality.rotationAndLowParallax: Retain 2D tracking and deferred finite-depth initialization.
quality.sourceOracleAndGpuRegression: Six focused cases compare complete raw outputs to the unchanged f32 reference; same-backend grouped/separate arrays and status/iteration words are exact. Omitted-option default and exact original working-budget regression pass.

result.defaultDecision: batchPasses remains false; no automatic promotion or input-size heuristic. Legacy adaptive minimum 64, explicit grouped minimum 128.
result.reason: Synthetic translation expansion median improves 10.9%, but ordinary photo expansion is near-flat (-1.0% time), photo pipeline +1.2% time, uploaded video expansion +3.6% and pipeline +4.4%. No additional general photo/video acceleration is established.
result.transferCounters: Upload/readback/snapshot counts unchanged; no new resident GPU arrays or patch buffers.
